issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method signature differs between the exercise spec/template and the solution. The problem statement and template expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a String (the UML and the example usage in Main call r.messageOnRide() with no parameters). The solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and Pig/Seal implement the one-parameter version. This parameter mismatch will cause compilation errors or confusion: students who implement a no-arg messageOnRide() as described in the assignment will not match the solution's interface (and the solution's implementations will not match the template's example calls).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the messageOnRide method signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred: change the solution to match the problem/template by removing the equipment parameter (Rideable should declare String messageOnRide(); Pig and Seal should implement a no-arg messageOnRide() that returns strings like "Riding on Pig [name]" and "Riding on Seal [name]"). Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement, UML, and the template Main.java to call messageOnRide(String) and document the parameter and its purpose so all artifacts use the same signature.
